final_decision.rationale: block_boundary=2.575 (>1.05, 0%FP) confirmed JPEG on all 5 pairs. Severity sweep 1-5 gave 31.29-35.42 dB at sev 2-5, while sev 1 (quality=25) reproduced the target exactly (PSNR=inf, CI 10/10) and also reproduced all four support pairs exactly. A blur control (gaussian:1 + jpeg:1) fell to 39.56 dB, ruling out blur despite gm_ratio=0.615. Peeled residual after jpeg:1 is identically zero (std=0.0), ruling out noise and global steps. Legal pipeline: one compression step, within the blur/noise/compression-each-once, max-3-steps constraint.
